name: Revision Consumer
summary: Consumes deterministic append-only revision successor assignments for versioned subjects.
description: Uses revision.successor-assign to derive the next append-only revision identifier and predecessor linkage for a versioned subject. Needs monotonic successor numbering without coupling the capability to any domain-specific artifact format or storage engine.

distinguished_from.how: Needs successor numbering for a generic versioned subject, rather than artifact-specific correction metadata and immutable lineage handling.
Consumes append-only successor assignment metadata, rather than a governed proposal approval application decision.
